subject: Activation steps — COI, endorsement, subcontractor disclosure
messages:
From: Procurement Team <procurement@securewave.io>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor docs for Redwood activation

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for taking our onboarding call this morning. Attached is our current Certificate of Insurance and a one-sheet with our broker contact. We also included a short subcontractor roster for the initial SOW.

Can you confirm what specific endorsements Redwood needs named on the COI (additional insured, waiver of subrogation, primary/non-contributory, etc.)? We want to expedite the PO and can submit an endorsement request to our carrier right away if you outline the exact language or a sample.

Files attached: SecureWave_COI.pdf (stub), Subcontractor_List.xlsx (stub), Broker_Contact.vcf (stub)

Request: would it be possible to receive a conditional PO number for onboarding systems while we await the carrier's endorsement (typical turnaround 5-7 business days)? Our finance team is ready to invoice once the PO is in place.

Best,
--
Procurement Team
SecureWave Technologies
procurement@securewave.io
(415) 555-0182


From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Procurement Team <procurement@securewave.io>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 11:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor docs for Redwood activation

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for sending the COI and subcontractor roster. A couple of clarifications so we can move this along: 

- COI: we require Redwood Inference listed as "Additional Insured" with an endorsement that mirrors ISO CG 20 10 or equivalent. The COI you sent shows the carrier and limits but does not include the additional insured endorsement language. Please request the endorsement from the carrier (or your broker) and provide the endorsement PDF.

- Primary/Non-Contributory: please confirm the policy is primary and non-contributory with respect to Redwood Inference. If the carrier cannot commit to exact wording, a written confirmation from the broker is acceptable as an interim item.

- Waiver of Subrogation: we prefer waiver of subrogation in favor of Redwood where permitted by law. If not possible, let us know.

- Subcontractors: the roster you shared is helpful — please identify any subcontractor who will handle customer data or have access to production systems. Highlight them in the spreadsheet and add a brief description of the controls they perform.

- W-9 and Remit To: our finance team needs a completed W-9 (for US entities) and your preferred remit-to instructions for invoicing.

We can issue a conditional PO (PO-4827) that will allow limited system access and provisioning while we await the formal endorsement, but final activation and billing will be contingent on receipt of the endorsement or a broker attestation. If you accept that path, notify us and we will route the conditional PO to your billing contact.

Attachments required to close: endorsement PDF (Additional Insured / CG 20 10), broker attestation if endorsement delayed, completed W-9.

Happy to jump on a quick call if that helps move the endorsement request with your broker.

Irene

--
Irene Choi
Vendor Onboarding Manager
Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwoodinference.com
(650) 555-0123

From: Allied Broker <broker@allied-ins.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@securewave.io>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor docs for Redwood activation

Hi Irene and SecureWave team,

Thanks for flagging the endorsement requirement. I've attached a draft endorsement request we submitted to SecureWave's carrier this morning; the carrier acknowledged and has appointed an underwriting contact. Their initial response: they can provide an Additional Insured endorsement but need to validate the CG 20 10 equivalence. Estimated turnaround is 3-6 business days.

We can also provide a broker attestation in the interim stating: 
"Allied Insurance confirms that SecureWave Technologies carries the insurance limits shown on the attached COI and that we have submitted a request for an Additional Insured endorsement naming Redwood Inference as Additional Insured. Carrier response is pending."

Files attached: SecureWave_COI.pdf (original), Endorsement_Request.pdf (sent to carrier, stub), Broker_Attestation.docx (stub).

From a practical standpoint, we understand a conditional PO is common and can be used to provision non-production credentials and start onboarding tasks while the endorsement is finalized. Please advise whether Redwood needs the broker attestation on your letterhead template (we can send one).

Regards,
--
Alex Martinez
Senior Account Executive, Allied Insurance
broker@allied-ins.com
(206) 555-0199

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Allied Broker <broker@allied-ins.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@securewave.io>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 15:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor docs for Redwood activation

Appreciate the quick response, Alex — and SecureWave, thanks for coordinating.

Next steps from Redwood: 
1) We will issue a conditional PO (PO-4827) today to allow SecureWave to be provisioned into our vendor portal and receive non-production API keys. This PO will be flagged "conditional: pending endorsement" and will not authorize billing beyond a $5,000 provisioning cap until the endorsement is received.

2) Please upload the broker attestation and the Endorsement PDF to the link below and reply with confirmation. Once the endorsement PDF is received and reviewed by legal, we will convert PO-4827 to a full activation PO and authorize invoicing.

   Upload link: https://app.redwoodinference.com/vendor-docs/upload/securewave

3) Finance needs the W-9 and remit-to details to set up payment terms. If you prefer, we can accept a signed DocuSign W-9; here is the link we sent to our vendor portal: https://docusign.net/securewave-limited-endorsement

4) For any subcontractors accessing production systems, please provide SOC2 or equivalent controls evidence for those subvendors or a controls summary in the spreadsheet.

If anything changes on timing, please flag immediately so we can pause the provisioning changes. Otherwise we expect the carrier endorsement to close the loop.

Thanks — I will follow up once PO-4827 is issued.

Irene

--
Irene Choi
Vendor Onboarding Manager | Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwoodinference.com | (650) 555-0123
